text: Platform form pattern imports must use the path `platform/forms-system/src/js/web-component-patterns` (not the full node_modules path or any other variation).

All local imports within (non-test source files) must use the `@bio-aquia/21-2680-house-bound-status-secondary/` webpack alias instead of relative paths (e.g., `../utils` or `./pages`). This applies to all source files under `src/applications/benefits-optimization-aquia/21-2680-house-bound-status-secondary/` except test files.
